entities.summary: Mason McDonald is a former Canadian professional ice hockey goaltender. He most recently played under contract to the Tulsa Oilers of the ECHL in 2021-22. He was selected by the Calgary Flames, 34th overall, in the 2014 NHL Entry Draft.
